coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Picture pages: rules, boxes and caption extents found as ink in each embedded JPEG at its own resolution (inklist.py, picx.hlines, picx.clusters), converted through the drawing matrix read from each page; every picture looked at; overlays looked at.

third_parties: custodian or trustee, authorization to vote (page 14)
signing.kind: Flat Rock Opportunity Fund subscription agreement, printed from a browser in landscape: five form pages, each one picture split across two PDF pages. The owner and co-owner sign on form page 5; the financial advisor signs form page 4; a custodian or trustee signs the voting authorization. No issuer acceptance block.
signing.note: Pictures are 1292x1672 px drawn at 0.4644 pt/px (x 33.75-633.75); the first PDF page of each pair shows picture rows 0-1198, the second the rest. Most places are rules with the caption on the same line; boxes run from the caption to the next caption, 10 pt above the rule.
